test_policy.notes: UC does not consider SAT or ACT scores in admission decisions or scholarships. Scores may be self-reported only after submitting the application, and are used for eligibility alternatives or placement after enrollment.

requirements.notes: Fee is $80 per campus, $95 for international applicants; fee waivers cover up to four campuses but only for U.S. citizens, permanent residents and AB540-eligible applicants. UCI does not accept or consider letters of recommendation.

deadlines.label: UC application filing period closes
deadlines.note: Admission decisions released March 1-31, 2027 (some campuses earlier)
deadlines.notes: No early plans. Application opens August 1, 2026 for fall 2027.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required if you completed all or some secondary school where English was not the primary language of instruction and had less than 3 years of instruction in English. The need for an exam depends on language of instruction, not citizenship. Take it no later than December; UCI uses the scores you self-report and requires official scores if admitted.

english.notes: Tests taken January 2026 or later (1-6 scale).
IELTS One Skill Retake not accepted.

aid.notes: UCI's international FAQ says it does not offer financial assistance for international students and points to external scholarships.

sat.note: UCI is test-blind; SAT/ACT are not used in selection. Code applies to scores sent after admission.

act.note: UCI is test-blind; code applies to scores sent after admission.

toefl.note: No undergraduate TOEFL code is published on the admissions pages (4859 appears only on UCI graduate pages). Self-report scores in the UC application; official scores are required if admitted.

tier_notes.business: Merage School offers a B.A. in Business Administration.
